prefixRule: Match case-insensitively on the install dir with a trailing separator kept, in any of three forms: the unix path (persistent under GPTK, only the first 1-2 s under CrossOver), the Z: form ('Z:' + the absolute path with backslashes), and for installs under the home dir the Y: form ('Y:' + the path relative to home with backslashes); the trailing separator stops 'Avernum 4 Remaster' matching 'Avernum 4'.
matchingProcess: CrossOver: the game exe process itself (Y:\ or Z:\ command line, persistent); the winewrapper/wineloader carries the unix path for 1-2 s only. GPTK (real gogdl launch): wine64-preloader carries the unix path to the exe for the whole run.
examples: CrossOver S1 (exe, home install): Y:\Projects\GameLib\...\Some Game\Game.exe
CrossOver S2 (explicit Z: arg): Z:\Users\<user>\Projects\GameLib\...\Some Game\Game.exe
GPTK real gogdl launch: .../wine/bin/wine64-preloader .../wine/bin/wine64 ~/Games/GameLib/Bloody Hell/Bloody Hell.exe
caveats: The live Task 2 launch used the GPTK engine (wine64), not CrossOver, so CrossOver's real gogdl exec shape is unconfirmed; the CrossOver evidence is the synthetic S1-S3 shapes.
Bottle names were only tested up to 120 characters; no rejection was seen, so the true cap is not measured.
